name: Meilisearch
description: Fast search engine API with typo tolerance and hybrid search

paths.name: Meili_Data
paths.description: Your indexes (data.ms), dumps, snapshots and this install's master key (.icestore-master-key). Keep the key private.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Meilisearch API and search preview, published on host as 6810

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: MEILI_ENV
variables.description: development shows the search preview page in the browser. production hides it and gives shorter error messages. Both need the master key.

variables.name: MEILI_NO_ANALYTICS
variables.description: true stops Meilisearch from sending usage data to its makers.
